title: Manual Evaluation Matters: Reviewing Test Protocols of Distantly Supervised Relation Extraction

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on noisy, distantly supervised (auto-labeled) test sets against manually human-annotated test sets to expose the performance skew and false-positive errors inherent in the standard automatic evaluation protocols.

Masking entity mentions during training and inference (e.g., using a BERT-M variant) to verify whether models overfit to shallow heuristics and prior knowledge associated with entity names rather than learning actual relational semantics from the text.
Reporting and analyzing both Macro F1 and Micro F1 scores to evaluate whether model performance is disproportionately skewed by heavily populated majority relation classes.
